name: Order and Clues
description: Eight invented logic puzzles about order, queues and shelves.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eight invented logic puzzles about putting things in order, shown on Brain Teasers.
help.goal: Nothing to win. Think it over, then reveal the answer when you are ready.
howToPlay: Read the teaser and take your time.
Press Hint for a nudge, if there is one.
Press Reveal answer to see the answer and why.
tips: Sketching little boxes on paper can help, but you never need to.
